name: Aegires E2EE
description: End-to-end encryption for Discord on Valenced, compatible with the Aegires Android app. Encrypts and decrypts text messages, images, GIFs, videos and files (up to 1 GiB) with a shared password, using Aegires v2 (Argon2id, AES-GCM). Per-chat on/off with /e2ee, a lock icon next to decrypted messages, a native video player, and a native module (C Argon2id with Kotlin/Java fallback) that makes key derivation much faster than plain JS.
author: Dark (https://github.com/system32crowdstrikewin11 "GitHub")
